thread:
jorge: Heads-up — Acme Travel (customer) opened an escalation: after today's rollout some translations are clearly worse for Romanian and Telugu. They gave side-by-side examples. Could we triage? :rotating_light:

priya: hi! i'm priya from Acme support. after the deploy at ~11:00 UTC a bunch of our translate calls to redwood-translate-1 started returning English or garbled text instead of the target language. this is breaking our UX. examples below (we tried 3 requests):

priya: request A:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-ACMEEXAMPLE" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-translate-1","input":"How do I get a refund?","target_locale":"te","temperature":0.0}'
```

priya: expected (Telugu): "రీఫండ్‌ను ఎలా పొందవచ్చు?"
priya: got (after rollout): "To get a refund, please contact support."  // returned in English and shorter

priya: request B:
```
{"model":"redwood-translate-1","input":"Can I change my booking date?","target_locale":"ro","temperature":0.0}
```

priya: expected (Romanian): "Pot să schimb data rezervării?"
priya: got (after rollout): "Change booking date — see policy." then a trailing repetition of English words "date date"

priya: request C (short prompt): target ro, input: "Where is my refund?" -> got blank or "" or random token sequence like "Refund.. Refund.."

jorge: customer included request IDs for some calls: 01HABCDEF1234567890, 01HABCDEF1234567891. they said these map to 11:03:22 and 11:04:10 UTC on our side.

maya: thanks, jorge. assigning. @anita @ken can you look at model/config changes in the 11:00 deploy? also need the exact model variant used — customer claim is redwood-translate-1 (unsuffixed).

deploy-bot: Deployment event: rollout/redwood-inference/2028-03-11-1100 completed on production. Changes: kernel-selection v4.8, kv-cache-defaults=true, batching-tweak=adaptive, quantize-profile=auto-int4 (applied to translate family).

anita: noted. quantize-profile=auto-int4 was intentionally enabled for some families to reduce cost. That should be transparent for quality, but for multilingual models tokenization/embedding quantization can cause odd regressions. I'll try to repro locally with the exact profile.

ken: runtime side — kernel swap + kv-cache-defaults shouldn't flip sampling or top-p. Confirming: no sampling param defaults were changed. Batching tweak could affect prefix caching if request shapes differ.

maya: jorge — can you ask customer for a minimal reproducible curl including headers (we need x-request-id and Authorization omitted) and confirm whether they used a model pin like redwood-translate-1@stable or left unpinned? also whether they saw this on Dedicated or Hosted?

jorge: forwarded to customer. they replied: Hosted (public api), no explicit @version in requests. they only used model name. also confirmed some earlier calls (yesterday) were fine.

anita: reproducer plan: run the three sample inputs against: (A) redwood-translate-1@pre-rollout-20280311 (B) redwood-translate-1@20280311-rc1 (C) redwood-translate-1@latest (prod). compare tokens, logits, and tokenizer outputs. I'll also diff token ids for Romanian/ Telugu examples to see if tokenization drift occurred.

ken: wen will collect runtime logs for request ids provided. if kv-cache changed behavior it might overflow prefix matching and trigger fallback behavior; but that usually causes latency, not language fallback. still checking.

maya: Can we get quick snapshots of customer responses for the two locales (original vs after) so we can attach to bug? jorge pls upload the exact strings to the ticket.

jorge: uploaded examples to the incident ticket (link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/INC-4829) — includes raw response bodies and headers.

anita: initial local run (toy repro against a dev checkpoint with int8 vs int4): int4 output showed higher chance of emitting English subphrases for Telugu test. suspected culprit: quantization + tokenizer bpe merge thresholds. leaving notes: token ids changed around boundary tokens for Telugu-specific script, causing model to select English subword pieces more often.

ken: adding runtime note: we had a minor change to batch packing that groups short text jobs more aggressively. For multilingual requests packed with English-heavy traffic we might be seeing kv-cache prefix collisions; engineering to check whether packed batches accidentally mix language contexts.

maya: high-level ask: revert quantize-profile for translate family in prod until we confirm fix? Product ok with temporary revert? @product (ping) — not in thread but will loop in.

anita: a revert would be safest short-term. I'll prepare a canary rollback plan for translate family. Meanwhile I'm testing a tokenizer-only fix that remaps some edge-case unicode sequences.

ken: if we do rollback, need to schedule low-traffic window; but we can roll back just the quantize-profile flag without touching kernel selection. i'd recommend do that first.

jorge: customer replied — they're seeing the regression across Europe and APAC customers, high priority. PR severity = P1 for them.

maya: OK, action items:
- anita: produce repro diffs and a proposed fix (tokenizer/quantization) — owner: anita — ETA 6h
- ken: check runtime batching/kvcache logs for the provided request IDs and whether mixed-batch packing occurred — owner: ken — ETA 2h
- jorge: keep customer updated and request any more failing ids — owner: jorge — ongoing
- maya: coordinate rollback approval if needed and notify product/infra — owner: maya — immediate

maya: tagging for visibility :eyes: @eng-ml @eng-runtime @product

anita: quick note — if anyone wants interim mitigation, ask customer to pin to a pre-rollout model version if available (redwood-translate-1@pre-rollout-20280311). pinned access is available for customers with support permissions.

ken: pulled logs for 01HABCDEF1234567890: batching group included mixed en + small translate jobs at 11:03:22. sending snapshot to ticket.

jorge: customer confirmed they can test pinned model; i'll share pinned endpoint and ask them to run same three cases and report back.

priya: ok i can test pinned now, will report in ~10m. thanks for fast responses.

[later — 11:06 UTC]
priya: pinned test results: redwood-translate-1@pre-rollout-20280311 returns correct Telugu sentence, Romanian good too. so pin fixes it.

maya: good repro. we'll proceed with rollback of quantize-profile for translate family while anita finishes tokenizer fix. will update incident ticket with plan and ETA for rollback.

jorge: communicated rollback plan to customer, will update when live. thanks all. :thumbsup:

(End of thread)
